name: comercial-platform
description: Plataforma multiempresa de prospección y ventas B2B

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @comercial/contracts && npm run build --workspace @comercial/domain && npm run build --workspace @comercial/db
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @comercial/api && npm run build --workspace @comercial/worker && npm run build --workspace @comercial/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
